knowledge_tree.title: Selective Compulsory English Book 3
knowledge_tree.content: Advanced English course for senior high school students focusing on comprehensive language skills, literature, and cultural awareness.

children.title: Unit 1: Art
children.content: Exploration of Western and Chinese art history, styles, and cultural significance.

children.title: History of Western Painting
children.content: Development of Western art from the Middle Ages to Modern Art.

children.title: The Middle Ages
children.content: Art focused on religious themes, primitive and two-dimensional style.

children.title: The Renaissance
children.content: Humanistic attitude, use of perspective and oil paints.

children.title: Impressionism
children.content: Emphasis on light and movement, subjective impression.

children.title: Modern Art
children.content: Abstract forms and questioning the nature of art.

children.title: Chinese Art
children.content: Traditional Chinese art forms including ink wash painting and bronzes.

children.title: Ink Wash Animation
children.content: Integration of traditional ink wash painting with animation techniques.

children.title: Tang Yin and Ming Dynasty Painting
children.content: Works like 'Clearing After Snow on a Mountain Pass'.

children.title: Shang Dynasty Bronzes
children.content: Ritual bronze objects from ancient China.

children.title: Tang Dynasty Sculptures
children.content: Buddhist sculptures influenced by Silk Road trade.

children.title: Language Focus
children.content: Grammar and vocabulary related to art and description.

children.title: Infinitives as Predicative
children.content: Using infinitives to describe purposes and aims.

children.title: Art Vocabulary
children.content: Terms like realism, sculpture, contemporary, etc.

children.title: Unit 2: Healthy Lifestyle
children.content: Understanding and developing healthy habits and lifestyles.

children.title: Habit Formation
children.content: The cycle of cue, routine, and reward in habit formation.

children.title: Habit Cycle
children.content: Cue triggers routine which leads to reward.

children.title: Changing Bad Habits
children.content: Strategies to replace negative routines with positive ones.

children.title: Creating Good Habits
children.content: Using the habit cycle to build beneficial behaviors.

children.title: Personal Health Choices
children.content: Making informed decisions about diet, exercise, and relaxation.

children.title: Diet and Nutrition
children.content: Balanced eating and avoiding sugary foods.

children.title: Physical Activity
children.content: Importance of regular exercise for health.

children.title: Mental Health
children.content: Managing stress and finding healthy relaxation methods.

children.title: Language Focus
children.content: Grammar and vocabulary for discussing health and habits.

children.title: Infinitives as Subject
children.content: Using infinitives in subject position.

children.title: Health Vocabulary
children.content: Words like stress, diet, exercise, etc.

children.title: Unit 3: Environmental Protection
children.content: Addressing global environmental issues and solutions.

children.title: Climate Change
children.content: Causes and effects of global warming.

children.title: Greenhouse Effect
children.content: Natural and man-made greenhouse effects.

children.title: Consequences of Emissions
children.content: Extreme weather, rising sea levels, etc.

children.title: Global Initiatives
children.content: Policies and actions to reduce emissions.

children.title: Pollution and Conservation
children.content: Specific issues like air and water pollution and conservation efforts.

children.title: Air Pollution
children.content: Smog, causes, and historical context like London smog.

children.title: Water Pollution
children.content: Case study of Li River pollution and cleanup.

children.title: Waste Management
children.content: Reducing plastic use and proper disposal.

children.title: Language Focus
children.content: Grammar and vocabulary for environmental topics.

children.title: Direct and Indirect Speech
children.content: Reporting statements and questions.

children.title: Environmental Vocabulary
children.content: Terms like emission, sustainable, conservation, etc.

children.title: Unit 4: Adversity and Courage
children.content: Stories of overcoming challenges and perseverance.

children.title: Shackleton's Expedition
children.content: The Antarctic expedition of Ernest Shackleton.

children.title: The Journey
children.content: Challenges faced by the crew of the Endurance.

children.title: Survival on Elephant Island
children.content: Coping with harsh conditions and hope for rescue.

children.title: Rescue Mission
children.content: Shackleton's voyage to South Georgia for help.

children.title: Personal Qualities
children.content: Traits like leadership, perseverance, and optimism.

children.title: Leadership
children.content: Shackleton's decisions and care for his crew.

children.title: Teamwork and Morale
children.content: Maintaining spirits through music and shared duties.

children.title: Language Focus
children.content: Grammar and vocabulary for narrative and description.

children.title: Present Perfect Continuous
children.content: Describing ongoing actions with relevance to the present.

children.title: Adversity Vocabulary
children.content: Words like endurance, resolution, perseverance, etc.

children.title: Unit 5: Poems
children.content: Appreciation and analysis of English and Chinese poetry.

children.title: Forms of Poetry
children.content: Different structures and styles in poetry.

children.title: Nursery Rhymes
children.content: Simple, rhythmic poems for children.

children.title: List Poems
children.content: Poems that list items around a theme.

children.title: Cinquain
children.content: Five-line poems with specific syllable counts.

children.title: Haiku
children.content: Japanese form with 5-7-5 syllable structure.

children.title: Tang Poetry
children.content: Classical Chinese poems from the Tang Dynasty.

children.title: Poetic Devices
children.content: Techniques used in poetry to create effect.

children.title: Rhyme and Rhythm
children.content: Sound patterns that enhance musical quality.

children.title: Imagery
children.content: Descriptive language that paints vivid pictures.

children.title: Metaphor and Simile
children.content: Comparisons that deepen meaning.

children.title: Language Focus
children.content: Grammar and vocabulary for poetic analysis.

children.title: Relative Clauses
children.content: Using clauses to add information about nouns.

children.title: Poetry Vocabulary
children.content: Terms like stanza, rhyme, meter, etc.
